system.description: Crystalline fruit from the Scorchwoods orchard. Eating one makes you feel weird — and a gift of gem apples pacifies a knight captain (decreases the Knight Tracker by 1; living captains will not willingly repeat the trick). Sir Damon cannot be pacified by one; he is not alive. Magus Ulrik can be — but must be tricked into eating it. Fresh or candied fruit works on captains; the Wish Fish needs a fresh apple with a live worm. Fruit becomes dull stone outside the Scorchwoods.
